contexts.text: He said that... he wanted to suffer...
Some suffer things quite hard there; some, things not hard. These are what are called vastations.
(Such) suffer themselves to be led equally by the evil and the good; and they suffer much from the evil.
Suffers himself to be led by the Lord. AC 3573:3.
When man suffers the Lord to dispose... But, when man does not suffer the Lord to dispose...
If he is such that he does not suffer himself to be regenerated...
He who suffers spiritual light to inflow...
In proportion as man suffers himself to be led (by Him).
Rachel... suffered hard things () = the temptations of interior truth.
With those who suffer themselves to be regenerated... AC 5280:3. AC 6550, Signified. AC 6611.
But this is grief on account of what they themselves suffer, (and is not the mercy of charity).
They had (here) suffered themselves to be much seduced by the deceitful... The like happens to them there. These constitute the exterior skin.
(Such) suffer themselves to be led away into all kinds of evils...
They who are such because they do not suffer themselves to be led by the Lord...
When they have suffered the extreme things (of vastation)... they are finally saved. AC 7251.
(Thus) in proportion as man suffers himself to be led through good to truths, he is led by the Lord...

Fear nothing of the things which thou shalt suffer () = despair ye not when ye are infested by evils, and assaulted by falsities; because with those who are in goods as to life, and in falsities as to doctrine it cannot be otherwise. AE 121.
a. They who had perceived delight in the fact that others were suffering, were cast out.
